run_dense_retrieval_evaluation: run the FEVER single-hop dense retrieval evaluation script with a trained model checkpoint and corpus index
build_faiss_index: build a FAISS inner-product index from pre-computed 768-dimensional embeddings stored in a numpy file
encode_claims_with_model: encode FEVER claims into embeddings using a loaded UnifiedRetriever model and HuggingFace tokenizer
search_topk_documents: search the FAISS index for top-k matching documents given encoded claim embeddings
save_retrieval_outputs: save retrieval results with claim IDs, claims, and top-k document titles and texts to a JSON lines file
